subject.title: fix(skills): enforce byte-level cap on skill package downloads

question: Should all skill download specifications be subject to an unconditional 256 MiB limit, or does the supported compatibility contract require a different ceiling or scope?
rationale: Choosing a global resource-exhaustion boundary intentionally changes which existing skill artifacts can install, and neither tests nor contributor claims can establish that product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve a calibrated global cap
options.body: Audit bundled and representative external download sizes, select and document a safe fixed ceiling, then land the corrected enforcement path.

options.title: Narrow the capped surface
options.body: Apply the limit only where the registry or artifact contract guarantees a suitable maximum, preserving other supported download specifications.

options.title: Pause the hard limit
options.body: Do not merge a global ceiling until maintainers define the supported artifact-size and upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a calibrated global cap
recommendation.body: Audit bundled and representative external download sizes, select and document a safe fixed ceiling, then land the corrected enforcement path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current review timeline routes this security-boundary and compatibility choice to this account.
